answer: Rewards flow only to identities holding a minimum ocean of reputation accrued over epochs, so mass-registering cheap keys yields negative expected return and cannot outrun the cost of sustaining each identity. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its on-chain vertex identity; a sybil attacker forging N identities pays N stakes plus N work costs, while honest nodes recover stake after a verified delta of good behavior. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
